subheader: The caption names the table; the heading introduces it
lead: Three columns: what the feature is, what this plan gives, and whether it is in the price. The full-table variant fills the band; plan-column narrows it so it can stand beside a sibling.
note: The note is where the qualifications go, so the cells stay short enough to scan.

rows.title: The feature is the row header
rows.text: So a cell read on its own still knows which line it belongs to.

rows.title: The plan is the column header
The state is a named mark
A caveat sits under its value
A row outside the price keeps its place
rows.text: Hiding it would hide the difference between this plan and the next.
